comments: Input facts: ego is the car initiator and agent1 the pedestrian responder; pedestrian movement is transverse to the outgoing trafficway and does not follow another trafficway. Chosen assumptions: a four-approach junction with single-lane incoming and outgoing roads. Ego starts 6–9 m before its incoming-lane end, turns right at 4.5–5 m/s without a planned pedestrian yield; agent1 crosses from the right sidewalk 6–8 m into the outgoing road at 0.8–1 m/s. Once ego commits to the turn and comes within 12–13 m, agent1 pauses and resumes after ego is more than 18 m away. Right-front placement is checked relative to ego initial travel direction. All geometry, timing and the 18 s horizon are chosen assumptions; no marked crosswalk or collision is required.
